description.en: Product and certification hub for export sellers: SKU master data, pricing, inventory, channel status (Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, eBay), content readiness, compliance notes, lifecycle state, and a certificate expiry tracker (CE/FCC/RoHS/UN38.3/UKCA).
description.zh-CN: 面向出口卖家的产品与认证枢纽：SKU 主数据、定价、库存、渠道状态（Amazon、Shopify、TikTok Shop、eBay）、内容就绪度、合规备注、生命周期状态，以及认证到期追踪（CE/FCC/RoHS/UN38.3/UKCA）。

agentPrompts: Show me which certificates are expiring soon or already expired.
Summarize the latest products and flag what needs my attention.
Which products are at stock risk or not ready to publish on a new channel?
